assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks and unspecified cardiac arrhythmia, reporting intermittent episodes of dizziness and palpitations that are poorly correlated with standard ECG findings.
To evaluate for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other intermittent dysrhythmias that may be contributing to these transient neurological symptoms, a cardiac event monitoring study is indicated.
CPT 93271 is the cardiac event monitoring study code.
The denial was based on Reason Code CO-97.
The requested service is bundled into another covered procedure and is not separately payable under current policy guidelines.
No reimbursement will be issued for this specific line item.
The patient has the right to appeal this determination.
An appeal requires a written request detailing clinical necessity and supporting documentation within the timeframe specified in the provider agreement.
Failure to submit an appeal within the designated period may result in the finalization of this denial decision.
